text:
mina: ran the JS quickstart with the example service account (from invite link). first request gets `403 Forbidden` in the SDK and body says billing required. quickstart didn't mention this for invite flows.

mina: code: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-small', input: 'hey' });
```

ops_sam: @mina do you see any error details in the SDK error object? sometimes proxy returns 403 when tenant id header is missing.

mina: sdk error: `{ status: 403, code: 'forbidden', message: 'workspace_billing_required' }`

devon_devex: thanks. likely two things: 1) invite-only workspace hasn't completed billing handshake so calls are blocked, 2) if the service account token is from a personal workspace the proxy will block. can you confirm the service account id and the workspace id share the same org?

mina: service account is sa_88 from org_998. invite link created org_998. i never added card because i expected trial.

ops_sam: trials for invite-created orgs are auto-provisioned only after billing acceptance step. quick workaround: add card in console -> Billing, then ping billing-bot to refresh.

mina: added card, but still 403.

billing-bot: received refresh request for org_998. cache invalidation queued (ETA ~20s).

mina: retried 45s later, SDK now returns 402 with body `{"error":"payment_required","message":"credits_pending"}` — odd transition from 403->402.

devon_devex: that's our proxy fallback behavior when tenant metadata is half-applied. after billing is accepted the billing service toggles the tenant flag; edge caches sometimes surface 403 or 402 depending on which layer responded.

ops_sam: suggestion: for quickstart, detect invite flow and show a one-step banner: "If you joined by invite, accept billing to enable API calls" with an inline refresh button that calls `/internal/workspace/refresh`.

mina: regenerated the SA token bound to org_998 and retried — now 200 OK and reply text "hi". hooray. :tada:

devon_devex: great. filing a small DX task to update quickstart and SDK error messaging to map these states (invite->billing_needed; pending_refresh -> try-refresh).

ops_sam: also adding a note for the SDK team: surface original http body for non-2xx responses as `rawBody` on the error object to make troubleshooting easier.

mina: thanks, closing.
